attempts.bug_summary: The MAP_KEY_VALUE original type is converted to the generic map logical type rather than its dedicated MapKeyValue logical type annotation. This produces an incorrect annotation for that specific enum value while leaving the other mappings unchanged.

package org.apache.parquet.schema;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertAll;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import org.apache.parquet.schema.DecimalMetadata;
import org.apache.parquet.schema.OriginalType;

public class LogicalTypeAnnotationFromOriginalTypeTests {

  @Test
  void returnsNullForNullOriginalType() {
    assertNull(LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(null, null));
  }

  @Test
  void mapsSimpleOriginalTypesToCorrespondingLogicalTypes() {
    assertAll(
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.stringType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.UTF8, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.mapType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.MAP, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.mapType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.MAP_KEY_VALUE, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.listType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.LIST, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.dateType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.DATE, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.enumType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.ENUM, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.jsonType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.JSON, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.bsonType(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.BSON, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.IntervalLogicalTypeAnnotation.getInstance(),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.INTERVAL, null)));
  }

  @Test
  void mapsDecimalUsingProvidedScaleAndPrecision() {
    DecimalMetadata metadata = new DecimalMetadata(12, 4);

    assertEquals(
        LogicalTypeAnnotation.decimalType(4, 12),
        LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.DECIMAL, metadata));
  }

  @Test
  void usesZeroScaleAndPrecisionWhenDecimalMetadataIsNull() {
    assertEquals(
        LogicalTypeAnnotation.decimalType(0, 0),
        LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.DECIMAL, null));
  }

  @Test
  void mapsTimestampAndTimeUnitsAsMillisecondsOrMicroseconds() {
    assertAll(
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.timestampType(
                    true, LogicalTypeAnnotation.TimeUnit.MILLIS),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.TIMESTAMP_MILLIS, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.timestampType(
                    true, LogicalTypeAnnotation.TimeUnit.MICROS),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.TIMESTAMP_MICROS, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.timeType(true, LogicalTypeAnnotation.TimeUnit.MILLIS),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.TIME_MILLIS, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.timeType(true, LogicalTypeAnnotation.TimeUnit.MICROS),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.TIME_MICROS, null)));
  }

  @Test
  void mapsUnsignedAndSignedIntegerWidths() {
    assertAll(
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(8, false),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.UINT_8, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(16, false),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.UINT_16, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(32, false),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.UINT_32, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(64, false),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.UINT_64, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(8, true),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.INT_8, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(16, true),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.INT_16, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(32, true),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.INT_32, null)),
        () ->
            assertEquals(
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.intType(64, true),
                LogicalTypeAnnotation.fromOriginalType(OriginalType.INT_64, null)));
  }
}
